title: #TAE 003: Our Favorite Video Games
desc: Still amped up on video games, Brandon and Kenny talk about games that they're currently playing, as well as their top-three all-time-favorite games.

title: #TAE 004: Nostalgia of the 90s and 00s
desc: Kicking back for a walk down memory lane, Brandon and Kenny reminisce about some of their favorite 90s and 00s content. Games, TV shows, movies, and more!

short: Kenny Is Sick! Time for Some Announcements
desc: Kenny is sick! So instead, you get a few minutes of Brandon talking about our internet presence.

title: #TAE 007: Super Mario Odyssey Follow Up
desc: Brandon and Kenny recap their experience playing Super Mario Odyssey, as well as throw back to some old-school Mario days.

title: #TAE 008: Thankful for…
desc: Happy Thanksgiving! Brandon and Kenny reminisce on some Thanksgiving memories, compare their favorite foods, and talk a little too much on how awesome pumpkin pie is!

title: #TAE 009: The SNES Classic
desc: Brandon and Kenny spent some time with the SNES Classic and are ready to share some thoughts!

title: #TAE 010: Vroom!
desc: Finally changing up to something other than video games, Brandon and Kenny talk about their past cars and experiences with them.

title: #TAE 011: Origins
desc: Brandon and Kenny show how average they really are when it comes to the world of biology. They talk about the upcoming addition to the Martinez family: baby number three!

title: #TAE 012: Breath of Fresh Air
desc: Brandon and Kenny talk about the latest Zelda: Breath of the Wild DLC. Special guest appearance by Hogules.

title: #TAE 013: Merry Christmas!
desc: Merry Christmas, Enthusiasts! Brandon and Kenny talk about days of Christmas past (and present), including some of their favorite gifts.

title: #TAE 014: Happy New Year!
desc: Happy New Year, Enthusiasts! Brandon and Kenny kick off the new year by talking about their favorite things from 2017. Also, some news on our new publishing cycle.

title: #TAE 015: Star Wars
desc: Brandon and Kenny bounce around the Star Wars galaxy talking about their favorite characters, moments, and more! And minor correction: it's green, not blue! Sorry!

title: #TAE 016: In Sickness and Health
desc: Brandon and Kenny have been hit hard by illness the past few weeks, so they talk about the great time they had while not making podcasts.

title: #TAE 017: History Month
desc: As we close out the month of February, Brandon and Kenny talk about Black History Month and other cultural awareness issues.

title: #TAE 018: Weird and Memorable Food
desc: Brandon and Kenny talk about some of the weirdest, and some of the best, food they've eaten. Foodies unite!

title: #TAE 019: Nintendo Direct Recap (March 2018)
desc: Brandon and Kenny talk about the recent Nintendo Direct announcements, including the new games coming soon on the Nintendo Switch!

title: #TAE 020: Story Time!
desc: Brandon and Kenny managed to poorly plan this week's (late) episode, so they decided to tell some stories! They even talk about some of their behind-the-scenes podcast recording tips.

title: #TAE 021: MoviePass Frustrations
desc: Brandon and Kenny talk about the recent changes to the MoviePass unlimited plan and their frustrations with it. They also discuss ways to make it better, or maybe ideas on starting a service themselves…

title: #TAE 022: The Great Outdoors
desc: After a month-long hiatus, Brandon and Kenny are back to talk about the great outdoors… and how many animals Kenny has inadvertently killed.

title: #TAE 023: Föder
desc: Brandon and Kenny talk about all the crazy changes that have been happening over the past month and try to justify their poor posting schedule. Who knew that introducing a new kid in the world would change your priorities!

title: #TAE 024: We're Done with MoviePass
desc: Brandon and Kenny revisit the MoviePass debacle and continue to share their frustrations on the service. Is it time to jump ship? We'll see! Note: This was recorded on 07/29/2018, so there are some out-of-date comments made. However, our position still stands!

title: #TAE 025: Halo Bones
desc: Kenny recently picked up an Xbox One and Halo: The Master Chief Collection. Brandon and Kenny talk about some of the good, and bad, of the franchise and state of the Xbox.

title: #TAE 026: A Very Average Anniversary
desc: We're celebrating our one year anniversary of podcasting! Brandon and Kenny reflect on the last year of podcasts and talk about the future. We look forward to hearing from all of you on what you want to hear this next year!

title: #TAE 027: Season 2!
desc: After a short hiatus, Brandon and Kenny are back to kick off season two of The Average Enthusiasts! And speaking of seasons, what better to talk about than our favorite TV shows!

title: #TAE 028: Wedding Bells
desc: After nearly a year-long hiatus, Brandon and Kenny are back to resume the much anticipated Season Two of The Average Enthusiasts. So what's been going on for the last year? I think I hear wedding bells in the not so distant past…

title: #TAE 029: Watch Out!
desc: Kenny introduced Brandon to the world of Overwatch, and now that it's finally available on the Switch he is hooked! Brandon compares Overwatch to some of his past favorite FPS's, and gives his take on what it's like being a new player to such an immersive game.

title: #TAE 030: Enthusiasts+
desc: With so many streaming services to choose from today, Brandon and Kenny talk about the ones they're currently subscribed to and their favorite content from each. Brandon also pitches the idea of the end of the movie theater; will it last in Disney's new world of streaming new movies straight to your home?

title: #TAE 031: Eclectic Effect
desc: Brandon and Kenny talk about their past mixtapes and playlists, while later Brandon goes on a rant about the Spotify Effect and how it's impacting the music of today.

title: #TAE 032: Politically Incorrect
desc: After watching older Disney movies, Brandon reflects on how some of the content would not fly today. Brandon and Kenny talk about being PC in today's culture, and how that's changed over just the past couple of decades.

title: #TAE 033: Poor Cinema Culture
desc: Kenny learns that Brandon is very, very uncultured in his cinema tastes – so much so that he can't even name a favorite movie! The duo explores some of their favorite movies, while Kenny tries to drag a true favorite out of Brandon.

title: #TAE 034: Puppy Love
desc: There's a new member to the Graham family, and Kenny tells us all about it! The guys discuss current and past pets, as well as cultural acceptance of… eating them?

title: #TAE 035: Wash Your Hands!
desc: With the pandemic taking hold of the world, Brandon and Kenny offer some practical advice on how to avoid COVID-19.

title: #TAE 036: Pandemic Recap
desc: Wow, COVID-19 really did throw the world upside down. It's been over a year since we've recorded, so let's spend some time to catch up with Brandon and Kenny.

title: #TAE 037: Mo' Money
desc: Finances: one of the many interesting aspects in a relationship. Brandon and Kenny catch up and talk about staying in their financial lanes within their marriages, and share some kind-of-helpful and kind-of-not financial tips.
